title: Step 2 - Decision Tree Regression: Fixing Splits with rpart Control Parameter

cues.zh: 已準備建立，代表全部程式碼都能執行，因為不用再修改。

cues.zh: 我們逐段執行。

cues.zh: 看看決策樹迴歸的結果。

cues.zh: 也不需要特徵縮放，因為決策樹依據自變數條件建立，不依賴歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: So we're fine with that.
cues.zh: 所以沒問題。

cues.en: We definitely don't need to apply feature scaling and we can move on to the next step which is to create our models.
cues.zh: 確實不用縮放，直接進入下一步建立模型。

cues.en: So let's create it, executing.
cues.zh: 現在執行建立。

cues.en: Alright, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.zh: 迴歸器已建立。

cues.en: And now let's get our final verdict.
cues.zh: 接著取得最終判斷。

cues.en: Okay, so 160 K according to this person.
cues.zh: 這位員工說薪資是 160K。

cues.en: And now let's see the predicted salary according to our model.
cues.zh: 看看模型預測多少。

cues.en: So executing this and we get a $249,000.
cues.zh: 執行後得到 249,000 美元。

cues.en: Wow. Much higher than the salary mentioned by this person but let's not drop hasty conclusions and let's see what's happening on the graph here.
cues.zh: 遠高於他聲稱的薪資，但先別急著下結論，看看圖形發生什麼事。

cues.en: So I'm going to select all this and let's see what's happening with the decision tree regression results.
cues.zh: 選取全部程式，查看決策樹迴歸結果。

cues.en: Alright, that's what I thought.
cues.zh: 果然和我想的一樣。

cues.en: Okay, so we don't need to zoom on it.
cues.zh: 不必放大。

cues.en: We clearly see what's happening here.
cues.zh: 已經能清楚看到問題。

cues.en: It's plotting a straight horizontal line exactly like we saw in svr, but for Python for those of you who didn't follow the Python tutorial, know
cues.zh: 它畫出一條水平直線，和先前 Python 的 SVR 一樣；若你沒看 Python 教學，

cues.en: that we already encountered this situation when we get a straight horizontal line.
cues.zh: 我們曾經遇過這種水平直線。

cues.en: And actually in svr, this was due to the fact that we didn't apply feature scaling to our dataset.
cues.zh: 當時 SVR 的原因，是沒有對資料集做特徵縮放。

cues.en: So what do you think the problem is here?
cues.zh: 那你覺得這次的問題是什麼？

cues.en: Do you think it's due to the fact that we didn't apply feature scaling like for svr and we need to apply feature scaling to get a model filling properly the dataset?
cues.zh: 是否也像 SVR，因為沒縮放，所以需要縮放才能讓模型貼近資料？

cues.en: Well, as I mentioned in the beginning of this tutorial we definitely don't need to apply feature scaling for decision trees because decision tree regression models are based on conditions on the independent variables
cues.zh: 如本教學一開始所說，決策樹絕對不必做特徵縮放，因為模型依據自變數條件，

cues.en: that has nothing to do with euclidean distances.
cues.zh: 和歐幾里得距離無關。

cues.en: And you know, when we need to apply feature scaling, it's because the machine learning models are based on euclidean distances and we need to put all the independent
cues.zh: 需要縮放，是因為某些機器學習模型依賴距離，必須讓所有自變數

cues.en: variables on the same scale so that one independent variable is not dominating another one.
cues.zh: 位於相同尺度，避免一個變數主導另一個。

cues.en: But this is not the problem here.
cues.zh: 但這裡不是那個問題。

cues.en: This is not about feature scaling.
cues.zh: 和特徵縮放無關。

cues.en: You can try to apply feature scaling here and re-execute this, but you'll get the same problem with a straight horizontal line.
cues.zh: 你可以試著縮放再執行，仍會得到相同的水平直線。

cues.en: And of course, this is actually the decision tree model.
cues.zh: 這確實是一個決策樹模型。

cues.en: This is actually one model of decision tree, but this is of course not the best version of decision tree regression we want to get.
cues.zh: 只是某種版本，當然不是我們想要的最佳決策樹迴歸。

cues.en: So can you start seeing what's the problem here?
cues.zh: 開始看出問題了嗎？

cues.en: And especially after watching the intuition tutorial made by (mumbles), Can you spot the problem?
cues.zh: 尤其看過 Kirill 的直覺教學後，能發現問題嗎？

cues.en: Okay, I'm going to tell you this problem is related to the number of splits because you know the way the decision tree regression model was made is
cues.zh: 告訴你，問題在切分次數；因為決策樹迴歸是

cues.en: that it's making some splits based on different conditions.
cues.zh: 依不同條件進行切分。

cues.en: So the more conditions you have on your independent variables, the more you have splits.
cues.zh: 自變數的條件越多，切分就越多。

cues.en: And here we clearly have no split here because you know all the predictions are equal to $250,000.
cues.zh: 這裡顯然沒有切分，因為所有預測都約為 250,000 美元。

cues.en: So you know, it took all the different salaries for the different 10 levels here and made an average and just gave the average for all the levels.
cues.zh: 它把十個職等的全部薪資取平均，再將平均值給所有職等。

cues.en: So no conditions here, no splits and therefore that's absolutely not interesting especially for the potential that decision tree can have.
cues.zh: 沒有條件，也沒有切分，完全沒發揮決策樹的潛力。

cues.en: So what we'll do now is add a parameter here that will set a condition on the splits.
cues.zh: 現在加入一個參數，設定切分條件。

cues.en: You know, that's what I was telling you.
cues.zh: 這就是剛才提過的。

cues.en: We have several parameters in this rpart library and we can use these optional parameters to improve our model and make it more robust.
cues.zh: rpart 套件有多個選用參數，能改善模型，讓它更穩健。

cues.en: Well, this is exactly what we're going to do now.
cues.zh: 現在就要這樣做。

cues.en: We are going to get back to our part.
cues.zh: 回到 rpart。

cues.en: So I'm going to press F1 here.
cues.zh: 按 F1。

cues.en: Oh, actually this time our part is showing up. Okay, so great.
cues.zh: 這次 rpart 直接顯示了，很好。

cues.en: Our part is here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: And as I mentioned, our part has several parameters that we can use to make our model more robust.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，rpart 有許多可提升模型穩健性的參數。

cues.en: And the one we are interested in right now is one parameter that will correct this problem we had with the splits.
cues.zh: 現在關心的，是能修正切分問題的參數。

cues.en: So this parameter is actually the control parameter.
cues.zh: 也就是 control。

cues.en: And right now I'm going to give you a little trick to solve this problem on the splits we had just obtained here.
cues.zh: 我給你一個小技巧，解決剛才的切分問題。

cues.en: So I'm going to add this third optional argument.
cues.zh: 加入第三個選用引數。

cues.en: You know, to improve our model right now we are doing some model performance improvement.
cues.zh: 我們正在改善模型效能。

cues.en: So that's a thing that machine learning scientists do very often in their job.
cues.zh: 機器學習科學家的工作經常需要這樣做。

cues.en: So then we will get more advanced sections on it especially when we cover cross validations to find the best models, selecting the best parameters.
cues.zh: 後面會有進階章節，尤其是交叉驗證、選擇最佳模型與最佳參數。

cues.en: But here we'll just do some simple model performance improvement, and we'll just add this control parameter.
cues.zh: 但這裡只做簡單改善，加入 control 參數。

cues.en: And then I'm going to give you this little trick.
cues.zh: 接著是這個小技巧。

cues.en: So this little trick is to take the rpart library again.
cues.zh: 再次使用 rpart 套件。

cues.en: So we're taking rpart control here, which is a function.
cues.zh: 呼叫 rpart.control 函數。

cues.en: And in this function we're gonna add an argument.
cues.zh: 在函數中加入引數。

cues.en: As you can see here on this yellow rectangle here, we have the first argument that is men split.
cues.zh: 黃色提示框中的第一個引數是 minsplit。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we're interested in and that's what will solve our problem.
cues.zh: 正是我們需要的，也能解決問題。

cues.en: Because you know, actually we didn't have any split here because it just took the average.
cues.zh: 因為剛才沒有切分，只取了平均。

cues.en: So it's like we had no conditions on the independent variables and no splits.
cues.zh: 等於自變數沒有條件，也沒有切分。

cues.en: So to make sure we have some splits and some conditions on the independent variables, we will actually set min splits to one and that will solve the problem.
cues.zh: 為確保有切分與自變數條件，將 minsplit 設為 1，就能解決。
